combinations.obstruction: one direction of the Weil form: controls fail exactly where their zero lists predict and later than under the full form; twists fail only by pole term / coefficient identification
zero-blind: the bound uses smoothness and sign-constancy of Lambda on primes plus the Chebyshev envelope; the constant is a prime-gap statistic
Rayleigh-Ritz: compression can only delay the Weil onset; the mesh must resolve gamma_off; no control fails below 0.8 x its known onset
verified height restated in the modulation frequency alpha; exponent reads Theta only at supports beyond the zero-resolution scale
